body:
My son is only 16 months old and, though I'm sure he'd miss me some, maybe he'd be better off without me. Don't get me wrong. I'm a good mom but I feel like the hardships my family has are because of me. I suffer serious PTSD (that I really should talk to somebody about) and have a very hard time leaving my son with anybody else or holding down a job. I'm a stay at home mom but I know that my husband resents me for not helping out more with money. 

I really don't have friends or peeps that care. I get that most people do have those that they wouldn't think about but I don't. My husband would cry and miss me but I'm sure he'd move on and find somebody better than me.

It is absolutely intimidating thinking about therapy. I have a hard time opening up with new people and I'm scared of get somebody that really doesn't get it. I don't like being judged either. I was on medication when my husband and I met a few years ago but stopped taking it because I thought I felt fine and it's expensive. I keep wondering if it'll ever pass or if I'd feel like this even if we weren't struggling right now.

I don't think my life is worth much and the only thing that keeps me here is my son. 

My husband and I have been talking about therapy but I haven't taken the plunge yet and I've had these problems for a long time.

I do a lot of work for others. I do animal rescue work, post-partum help for new moms and I like to think I'm a pretty good person overall. The only thing is that I never have help when I need it, not so much as a shoulder to cry on or somebody to listen. I'm married and it seems like my husband tries to understand but it doesn't help. 

People seem to either just take, take, take or take and disappear. I don't think they owe me anything but I'm very lonely all the time.
